information: ## Participants and Spectators under 18 * Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. * Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will go towards supporting West Coast Cubing and the Cal Cube Club. ## Please read the "What is a Favorites Competition?" tab before registering. ## Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley! * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors may bring a maximum of two guests. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
